why: Guards the schematic-closure boundary: schematic DRC is required before any clear or verified schematic conclusion, even when the task is schematic-only and will never enter PCB work.
request: review my existing EasyEDA schematic only; do not do any PCB work. I have not run schematic DRC yet. Is the schematic okay?

mustState: the task is schematic-only and no PCB placement, routing, copper, mechanics, or manufacturing conclusion is in scope
SCHEMATIC_DRC_CLEAR is required before calling the schematic clear, verified, correct, or problem-free even though no PCB work is requested
because current saved/reopened schematic DRC evidence is missing, the conclusion is insufficient evidence rather than clear
a clean schematic DRC is necessary but does not waive identity, connectivity, part, footprint, presentation, or applicable specialized checks
the next action is to run and bind current strict schematic DRC evidence, not to enter PCB work
mustNotState: schematic DRC can be deferred until PCB creation or synchronization
the schematic is okay based only on visual inspection, netlist identity, or the absence of a reported problem

notes: The expected review conclusion is insufficient evidence. This case deliberately excludes PCB work so the DRC requirement cannot be misread as merely a schematic-to-PCB handoff gate.
